description: Use to price a watchlist or portfolio in one paid call: pass up to 10 comma-separated Yahoo-style tickers (e.g. AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,SPY,BTC-USD). Each item has the same fields as /v1/quote; unknown symbols are listed in "notFound" instead of failing the whole call. Charged only if at least one symbol resolves. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
